end.summary:
Discussed “unity in diversity” using music and festivals as examples.
Identified shared values such as gratitude, sharing, family time and thankfulness.
Gave examples of Pongal, Lohri, Diwali, Eid, language and regional dress.
The teach-back was not completed, though both assessed skills had two unaided correct attempts.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, clothes and festivals can share common values, using music as an analogy. They gave accurate examples of Pongal and Lohri, and connected Diwali and Eid with sharing and gratitude; the question about whether feelings count as values was clarified through later examples of thankfulness and happiness. At home, ask Riya to make a small two-column chart: “different forms” and “shared value.”
